company_overview.name: The Coca-Cola Company
company_overview.specialty: Manufacture, retail, and marketing of nonalcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups
notable_facts: Invented the original Coca-Cola beverage in 1886.
One of the world's largest beverage companies offering over 500 brands.
Products are available in more than 200 countries.
Known for iconic branding and marketing campaigns globally.

founding_year_and_mission: Founded in 1886, The Coca-Cola Company's mission is to refresh the world, inspire moments of optimism and happiness, create value and make a difference.

financial_and_business_metrics.ownership: Publicly traded company with shares listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KO). Major shareholders include institutional investors.
financial_and_business_metrics.customers: Global consumer market comprising retail, food service, vending machine operators, and distributors.

product_and_market: The Coca-Cola Company offers a broad portfolio of nonalcoholic beverages including sparkling soft drinks, water, sports drinks, juices, teas, coffees, and energy drinks. Its flagship product is Coca-Cola soda. The company operates in a highly competitive global market, focusing on innovation, brand management, and extensive distribution.
geographic_presence: The Coca-Cola Company has a global presence with products available in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide through an extensive system of bottling partners and distributors.
